name: VastTrack
description: In this paper, we introduce a novel benchmark, dubbed VastTrack, towards facilitating the development of more general visual tracking via encompassing abundant classes and videos. VastTrack possesses several attractive properties: (1) Vast Object Category. In particular, it covers target objects from 2,115 classes, largely surpassing object categories of existing popular benchmarks (e.g., GOT-10k with 563 classes and LaSOT with 70 categories). With such vast object classes, we expect to learn more general object tracking. (2) Larger scale. Compared with current benchmarks, VastTrack offers 50,610 sequences with 4.2 million frames, which makes it to date the largest benchmark regarding the number of videos, and thus could benefit training even more powerful visual trackers in the deep learning era. reputation: A large-scale and relatively recent tracking benchmark that is gaining attention for its breadth of object categories and sequence count, but is less established than long-running trackers like GOT-10k or LaSOT.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; includes both bounding-box tracking and language descriptions, with evaluation centered on standard tracking metrics.
